name: Choose Kitten
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Drag the fish toy and tap the cats that don’t spin.
Use the hairdryer and tap the rude cat.
Use the ghost costume and tap the scared cat.
Give the textbook and tap the cats that ignore it.
Use the microphone and tap the loud cat.
Use the laser pointer and tap the destructive cat.
Reveal the female cat and tap the flirty kitten.
Give the food and tap the kitten that eats anything.
Open the blinds and tap the sneezing kitten.
Open the cabinet and tap the gluttonous kitten.
Use the toy dog and tap the aggressive kitten.
